title: DirployConfig
description: Configuration file schema for Dirploy static publisher

$schema.description: URL to the JSON schema for validation

source.description: Static directory containing the build output to publish

path.description: Destination directory inside the GitHub User Site repository

localRepo.description: Path to local clone of User Site repository for fast reference cloning

domain.description: Custom domain for the published site URL

clean.description: Whether to remove existing files in the destination directory before deploying

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from deployment

nojekyll.description: Create .nojekyll in repository root if missing to prevent Jekyll processing
